spans.says: Scaling a growth team used to meet headcount. Now a team of one can run the same experiment program that used to take a team of five. And a team of five could run the same experiment program that used to take a team of 20. Welcome to the AI world.
Execution goes to agents, build the variants, draft, instrument, ship, analysis, the agent drafts the readout. A human calls it scrap or scale.
Fewer people, higher velocity. Every human hour on a call, only the human should make.
